entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Showers are expected to turn to snow for a time this afternoon. Up to 1 cm may accumulate above 900 metres. Another period of snow showers may affect the road Saturday morning between 4am and 8am when another 1 cm may accumulate.
